title: The Life of Donald Trump — Who Donald Trump Really Was #Shorts
description:
The private years of Donald Trump explain the public decades better than any speech. Donald John Trump (born June 14, 1946) is an American politician, media personality, and businessman who is the 47th president of the United States. A member of the Republican Party, he served as the 45th president from 2017 to 2021.

Between the birth and the legend of Donald Trump lie the years that actually decide it.
